analysis.title: TransDigm Group (TDG): F4Q26 First Take: Strong qtr; issued FY27 revenue and EBITDA guide above consensus
key_insights: TDG reported F4Q26 adjusted EPS of $12.44 vs FactSet consensus $12.21, with revenue, EBITDA and EPS all ahead of consensus on organic sales growth of 14% and a 53.0% EBITDA margin.
Segment growth: commercial aftermarket up 15% yoy (up 17% last quarter), commercial OEM up 17% (up 17% last quarter), defense up 12% (up 11% last quarter).
Within commercial, transport aftermarket/OE are up 16% and 25%, and bizjet/heli aftermarket/OE are up 21% and flat yoy.
EBITDA as defined of $1.58bn is above consensus of $1.55bn, on a 53.0% margin vs consensus 52.6%.
Initial FY27 guidance: revenue $11.95-$12.15bn (vs FactSet consensus $11.78bn) and EBITDA as defined $6.195-$6.345bn (vs consensus $6.182bn), both above consensus.

FY27 adjusted EPS guide of $47.09-$47.94 is below FactSet consensus of $48.72. GS says the company likely accounts for higher net interest expense, with FY27 interest expense guided to about $2,255mn.
Versus GS estimates, F4Q26 adjusted EPS of $12.44 was $0.08 (0.7%) below GS at $12.52, and reported EPS of $10.33 was below GS at $11.23. Total sales of $2,988mn were 0.4% above GS.
Within the GS comparison, commercial OEM revenue of $683.7mn was 6.1% below GS, commercial aftermarket of $983.1mn was 3.9% above, and defense matched GS at $1,254.8mn.
EBITDA margin of 53.0% was down 110 bp yoy from 54.1% in F4Q25. D&A of $122mn was above GS at $80mn, and other loss of $50mn compared with a GS estimate of zero.
GS rates TDG Buy with a 12-month price target of $1,745 (20.0x target CY27E EV/EBITDA), 43.2% upside from the $1,218.85 close on 9 Nov 2026.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps its Buy and $1,745 target after a quarter ahead of consensus and an FY27 revenue and EBITDA guide above consensus. The target uses 20.0x CY27E EV/EBITDA and implies 43.2% upside.

earnings_insights: F4Q26 adjusted EPS $12.44 reported 11/10 vs FactSet consensus est $12.21 and GS est $12.52. Reported (GAAP) EPS $10.33 vs GS est $11.23.
F4Q26 revenue $2,988mn reported, up 22.6% yoy on GS's table and up 14% organically, vs GS est $2,976mn.
F4Q26 EBITDA as defined $1.58bn reported vs FactSet consensus est $1.55bn, margin 53.0% vs consensus est 52.6%.

FY27 guidance (initial, issued with F4Q26): revenue $11.95-$12.15bn vs FactSet consensus est $11.78bn, EBITDA as defined $6.195-$6.345bn vs consensus est $6.182bn, adjusted EPS $47.09-$47.94 vs consensus est $48.72, GAAP EPS $42.06-$42.91.
FY27 guided EBITDA margin is 51.8-52.2%, interest expense about $2,255mn, tax rate about 22%-24%, weighted shares 56.7mn and capex $365-$395mn.
FY27 organic end-market growth guide: commercial OEM up high-single-digit to low-double-digit %, commercial aftermarket up high-single-digit %, defense up high-single-digit %.
